row: 台北 101 高 508 公尺，2004 年底啟用，曾是世界最高的大樓；塔身八節、每節八層，88 至 92 樓懸有 660 公噸的調諧質量阻尼器。

airspace.zh: 台北市區多屬禁限航區（含松山機場周邊），飛行前請以民航局系統查詢；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Much of central Taipei is restricted airspace (Songshan Airport and more). This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

spire.note: look point near the top (about 470 m)

tagline.zh-Hant: 冬至前的夕陽，滑過雲海上的塔尖
tagline.en: A winter sunset slides past the spire above a sea of cloud

zh: 冬至前的台北，盆地被雲海填滿。
只有台北 101 的上半段，露出雲層。
en: Taipei just before the winter solstice: the basin is filled with a sea of cloud.
Only the upper half of Taipei 101 rises above it.

zh: 大樓高 508 公尺，2004 年 12 月 31 日正式啟用。
曾是世界最高的大樓，直到 2009 年被哈里發塔超越。
en: At 508 m, it officially opened on 31 December 2004.
It was the world's tallest building until the Burj Khalifa passed it in 2009.

zh: 塔身分成八節，每節八層。
像寶塔、像竹節，也像一疊古代的元寶。
en: The tower rises in eight segments of eight floors each.
They recall a pagoda, a stalk of bamboo and a stack of ancient ingots.

zh: 88 到 92 樓之間，懸著一顆 660 公噸的鋼球。
強風吹來時，它擺動來抵消大樓的晃動。
en: Between the 88th and 92nd floors hangs a 660-tonne steel pendulum.
In strong winds it swings to offset the sway of the building.

zh: 高速電梯從 5 樓到 89 樓，只要 37 秒。
完工時，它是世界上最快的電梯。
en: Its express lifts climb from the 5th to the 89th floor in 37 seconds.
When the building opened, they were the fastest in the world.

zh: 東側的象山海拔 183 公尺，是看 101 的熱門步道。
今天，它沉在雲海底下。
en: Xiangshan, 183 m, to the east is a favourite trail for views of Taipei 101.
Today it lies beneath the sea of cloud.

zh: 從象山的方向望去，夕陽沉向 101 的塔尖。
12 月下旬，台北的太陽落在西南方。
en: Seen from the direction of Xiangshan, the sun sinks toward the spire.
In late December, Taipei's sun sets in the south-west.

zh: 太陽貼著塔尖滑下，雲頂被染成橘紅。
依當天的日照計算，這是太陽與塔尖重疊的時刻。
en: The sun slides down past the spire and the cloud tops glow orange.
By that day's sun position, this is when the sun and the spire line up.

zh: 太陽沒入雲海。
這片雲海是模擬的效果；真實的雲海要看天氣。
en: The sun sinks into the sea of cloud.
This sea of cloud is simulated; a real one depends on the weather.

zh: 日落後，雲海從橘紅轉成紫色。
101 的塔頂，還留著最後的光。
en: After sunset the sea of cloud turns from orange to violet.
The top of Taipei 101 still holds the last of the light.

zh: 2011 年，它取得 LEED 白金級綠建築認證，
成為當時世界上最高、最大的綠建築。
en: In 2011 it earned a LEED Platinum rating,
becoming the tallest and largest green building in the world at the time.

zh: 本片為擬真畫面：101 以簡化造型重建，
雲海為模擬效果，日照依當天計算。
en: Simulated: Taipei 101 is a simplified model,
the sea of cloud is an effect, and the light follows that day's sun.
